name: relation-view-more
goal: Show four relationships per module type and reveal four more without changing scope or other groups

evidence: Each module type in Used In and Uses starts with four rendered catalog rows; View More appends four more independently, disappears at the end, and preserves navigation scope. Changing entity, tab or revision resets batches.

Existing shared relationship browser matrix uses at most two rows per type. Extend its shared fixture with nine of every module kind, and the same matrix with partial/final batch, independent type, keyboard focus and reset assertions.
